Shop My Account Visit Getting Here In The Park Shop & Dine Shakespeare on the Sound performs in Pinkney Park on the banks of the Five Mile River in Rowayton, CT.
There's no better way to spend a summer evening then by watching professional actors perform Shakespeare in this picturesque waterfront setting.

Whether this is your first time with Shakespeare on the Sound or your twenty sixth, this guide will provide an overview of what a night in the Park can look like and help you to make the most out of your time with us.
​ Contact Need to get in touch?

​ Contact our office at (203) 957-1006 or at contactus@shakespeareonthesound.org TICKETS Much Ado About Nothing - June 10-28 J une 16-23 and all Tuesdays are Pay What You Will Suggested donation amounts are $25 for adults, and $15 for seniors over 65 and students, $5 for children 12 and under .
​ June 10-28 on Wednesdays through Sundays General Admission $25 for adults, and $5 for children 12 and under.
$15 rush tickets for seniors over 65 and students.
​ Reserved seating to our shows any day of the week is $75.
Please take a look at our Reserved VIP Seating page to learn more!
We are featured in TravelMag's 20 Unique Things to Do in Connecticut !
